cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your bow at the ceremony was adequate. Mine follows the founder's original diagram.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder asked us to wave instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. His original diagram is in the constitution. My bow follows that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you have a signed exception. I'll bow on behalf of everyone still governed by the constitution.

mechanism: A uses its ceremonial pupil new founder permission as an occasion to rank the pupil exception beneath A constitutional method.
confusable: Not simply enforcing one known rule: each better piece of B authority becomes a narrower category so A retains more legitimate practice.
comparison: Organizational paperwork absorption versus constitutional precedence over signed personal exception.
seedUse: D187 bow/wave/founder diagram/constitution/signed programme; S05 taught ceremony and annotated permissions.
